take: Per the Capitals' announcement, Washington acquired goalie Remi Poirier from New Jersey for a 2027 seventh-round pick and placed defenseman Dylan McIlrath on waivers; New Jersey says it received the pick for Poirier. McIlrath played 4 games this season at 6.58 minutes a game with no points, and Washington's share of expected goals (the quality of chances) at 5-on-5 was 51 percent with him on the ice. Our numbers have nothing on Poirier. Washington (8-4-0) is 4.7 goals saved above expected, while New Jersey (9-5-0) is minus 5.4, so the swap involves a team whose goaltending has been strong and one whose goaltending has not.
